limitations.block_walkability_and_construction_volum: Eight-block samples cannot prove collision clearance, exact grades, road earthwork or tree-removal volume.
limitations.cave_mouths_ravines_natural_bridges: Section-palette presence cannot locate entrances, tunnels, overhangs or bridge geometry.
limitations.component_resolution: Broad-family/elevation/relief/cover/snow segmentation with sub-24-sample noise absorption. These are analysis resolutions, not target region counts; large regions can conceal passes and internal hierarchy.
limitations.continuation: Local class is determined only by bounded unsupported geography. The preserved broad forward flood is deep_network_reach; its historical class/counts are legacy diagnostics, never local eligibility or shape scores. Local horizons reuse operational band markers on geometric Homeland Depth, provisionally; they are not Travel Cost targets.
limitations.homeland_depth: Shortest horizontal graph length from outward homeland edges, independent of rise/canopy cost. Potential water/major-grade relationships are optimistic geographic links, not proven traversal. Travel fields separately expose dependency.
limitations.manual_evidence: The supplied manual review of 930010639 establishes useful geographic hierarchy as an analyzer test. Missing recognition is an analyzer limitation, not automatic seed rejection.
limitations.physical_network_connectivity: Finite surface costs include water opportunities; inferred joins and reachable bands do not prove block-level traversability or grade-separated intersections.
limitations.resource_equivalence: No ore, food, animal, crop or full homeland resource portfolios in the committed grid.
limitations.selection: Existing 65-effective-block travel calibration remains a soft travel cost only. Homeland Depth has no invented target; a map-relative depth cost favors earlier handoff. Joint pool/exit caps are computational, not desired topology.
limitations.topology: Matrices use same-sample forward minimax-depth meetings, not merely touching a large region. All depth/branch/convergence counts are descriptive; there is no mathematical-center requirement or winning seed.
limitations.travel_time_hunger_and_level_access: Effective blocks are an explicit analytical cost, not measured time, Hunger expenditure or level gates.
limitations.true_chokepoints: Surface clearance proxies cannot establish mandatory chokepoints with caves, boats and player modification available.
limitations.visibility_and_landmark_prominence: No sightline/canopy-volume analysis; landmarks are surface-geography candidates.
limitations.water_depth_and_fords: Water mask and terrain height do not provide a reliable water-column depth or crossing clearance.
limitations.water_semantics: Connected inland water systems and opposite-bank sample runs distinguish access, crossing candidates and barriers. Up-to-32-block runs are conditional modest candidates, not verified shallow water or approved bridges. Longer/ocean links enter only the major-or-unverified sensitivity graph: boats could avoid major construction, but transport and fords are unmeasured.

local_analysis_policy.backward_guard: Fixed start-depth minus one sample diagonal, never reset during traversal.
local_analysis_policy.branch_evidence: Residual connected components merge all within-horizon reconvergence. Require existing four-sample feature support and at least three sample spacings of radial extent beyond the removed core, plus one sample of depth gain or a persistent new region.
local_analysis_policy.core_removal: Remove the one-sample-diagonal physical path neighborhood around the terminus.
local_analysis_policy.horizon: Upper edge of the next existing operational depth band after the band containing the handoff; exact boundaries enter the next band.
local_analysis_policy.lateral_detour_guard: Physical graph path budget = twice the derived forward horizon span; bounds sideways floods and long water jumps, not a travel-cost ceiling.
local_analysis_policy.open_ended_guard: Beyond the last finite band, extend by its existing width (350-250), computationally only; no new deep gameplay band.
local_analysis_policy.resolution_limit: Open connected land counts as one choice; sampled paths do not prove legible valleys/passes. Branching beyond the removed core in one connected component is deliberately not separate immediate choices.
local_analysis_policy.shape: 0 dead_end, 1 directed, 2 branching, 3+ junction. No ordinal quality or branch bonus.

policy.arrival: Connected same-feature dry samples within the existing 32-block analytical approach scale; diagnostic only. One anchor can remain if evidence is sparse.
policy.commitment: Qualitative dependency/geometry proxies, not fixed distance bands: natural starter low, modest medium, major high; exploitation/return unresolved where payoff or water navigation is unverified; exposure always unresolved.
policy.comparison: Compare claimed entered systems with outward homeland sources, and remote water contacts with origin shore/system context. Different biome alone is never payoff.
policy.completion: Complete/Structurally Supported refer only to sampled analytical evidence, never physical readiness. Missing evidence is conservatively Incomplete with an unresolved reason, not proof of terrain failure.
policy.cover_persistence: Use existing forest/highland masks on the modest dry graph. Existing 24-sample formation support plus four inward sample layers distinguish a core from a thin strip. This diagnostic heuristic is not eligibility or resource proof.
policy.mode: Shadow only. Consume frozen local-continuation fits; never call selection, refit routes, or change eligibility.
policy.near_shore_payoff: Village edge within the existing 32-block approach scale of a reachable shore is conditional landfall access; payoff may be far from the initial handoff along the water. No unlimited shore-to-any-village flood.
policy.payoff: Only observed village footprints and demonstrated differentiated geographic-system projection count as observed. Remote persistent-system/landmass access can be potential. Ore, crops, animals, caves and other structure access/value are unmeasured. No authored locations.
policy.rejected_sample: Deterministic best-utility examples per feature kind, local-dead-end, locally-valid, water, village and duplicate-opportunity strata; at most 12 per homeland, not exhaustive or a new ranking.
policy.water: Cardinal connected samples whose recorded surface block is water; ice/other surfaces excluded. Adjacent former ocean/inland IDs can share a diagnostic network, but active water identities are unchanged. Sample continuity is conditional, not boat clearance or depth proof.
policy.water_ports: Connected shore contacts grouped by frozen region and diagnostic water network; at least four shore samples. Region ID alone is not distinct value. Different land components or persistent forest/highland systems provide projection context.
policy.water_shape: Double-sweep geodesic extent is a lower bound. At least the inherited 32-block continuation scale and length >= twice area/length indicate corridor geometry provisionally. Multiple distinct shore contexts support network geometry. Neither proves payoff.
